title: Kunneth formula for Hessian manifolds
summary: We study Dolbeault--Koszul cohomology $H^{p,q}(M)$ of flat affine manifolds. We proove a Künneth formula \[ H^{p,q}(M\times N) \cong \bigoplus_{i,j} H^{i,j}(M)\otimes H^{p-i,q-j}(N) \] for flat affine manifolds $M,N$ with at least one compact. For compact manifolds we also give a proof via Hodge theory on flat affine manifolds, analogous to the classical Künneth formula for Dolbeault cohomology. We apply this formula to Hessian manifolds.
